Reading two wins because the clause after the dash is the operative ground and the round references only note that answers were given, with no finding that either chain of many verses failed.", "why": "The judge rests UNDERDETERMINED on the single verse Matthew 1:16 admitting both the link's reading and its contrary, which K-S2 expressly forbids as a ground."}
